text:
incident-bot: PAGER: P2 - spike in EU-west economy-tier tail latency and 5xxs. alert: grafana/alerts#EU_ECONOMY_LATENCY. start=2766667777. paging oncall. link: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/xyz

maria (oncall): Acked. I'm looking at dashboards now.

ashish: queue depth on economy GPUs is through the roof. KV cache miss rate jumped ~3x right after the model swap at 09:01 UTC. looks like cache warm-up + a few noisy tenants.

lucy (sre): customer-facing impact? seeing increased 503s from served API?

nora (acct): quick check - two paying customers showing elevated error rates: acct-42 (payment infra) and acct-88 (search vendor). small number of dev orgs too.

kevin (sre): Triage proposal: 1) immediately throttle economy tier throughput to ~50% to reduce queueing 2) enable temporary region-steer: route eu-west calls to priority lane (higher cost, lower latency) for next 30m 3) soft-raise quotas for acct-42 and acct-88 so their jobs don't get killed 4) disable non-prod economy pref to free slots. anyone object? :thumbsup:

maria (oncall): No objections. I'll apply routing change now. running admin policy change.

maria (oncall): ```bash
# temp steer: move half of eu-west economy traffic to priority lane for 30m
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/v1/routing/policies
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{
    "policy_id":"adaptive-priority-slope-2766667777",
    "region":"eu-west",
    "actions":[
      {"target":"economy","weight":-0.5},
      {"target":"priority","weight":0.5}
    ],
    "duration_seconds":1800,
    "note":"temp steer to relieve economy GPU queue"
  }'
```

deploy-bot: routing-policy apply acknowledged. change_id=rp-2026-03-15-09-07-04 by maria. status: applied -> active.

lucy (sre): setting a tightened latency alert (95th) at 10% above baseline for the next 45m. also enabling extra retention on slow traces.

ashish: also pushing a quick config to disable economy preference for non-prod orgs so they fall back to best-effort instead of claiming economy slots. snippet below:

maria (oncall): ```yaml
# quick toggle - non-prod economy opt-out
routing.flags.non_prod_economy_preference: false
# rollout via config service
POST /admin/configs/flags 
body: {"key":"routing.flags.non_prod_economy_preference","value":false,"actor":"maria"}
```

kevin (sre): Done. Verified on the dashboard: economy GPU queue depth dropped ~60% in 60s, backend 5xxs reduced to normal range. 95th latency trending down. Will keep this mitigation for 30m and watch.

maria (oncall): Handing off to lucy at 09:40 UTC. I'll stay available if something regresses. Hand-off notes: change_id rp-2026-03-15-09-07-04, affected tenants: acct-42, acct-88, non-prod orgs unscheduled.

lucy (sre): Ack. I'm on for 30m. I'll open a follow-up postmortem ticket if baseline doesn't stabilize to pre-swap levels. tagging @cs for acct outreach.

nora (acct): I'll contact acct-42 and acct-88 now, let them know we gave a temporary quota bump and routed traffic to priority lane. requesting logs/trace ids.

incident-bot: Monitoring note: passive watch for 15m post-mitigation before auto-close. please add any customer impact notes here.

maria (oncall): Initial customer-impact assessment: degrade for a handful of users (short-lived 503s) but no data loss. enterprise tenants retained throughput after soft quota bump. recommend post-incident review: - why cache miss spike after model swap - consider staged model swap + cache pre-warm - validate routing policy defaults for swap windows.

kevin (sre): Agreed. I'll create the follow-up bug and assign to infra + runtime. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
